verdict.rationale: NVIDIA's own product page explicitly documents DLSS 4 AI-upscaling/frame-gen support on the RTX PRO 6000 and ties it to ray-tracing and 'AI-enhanced graphics tools' for gaming use cases, but this is a professional workstation card whose docs give no game-count or compatibility list, and FSR (competitor tech) is not mentioned at all. Missing for 10: explicit broad game-support list/benchmarks, FSR support details, independent gaming-performance corroboration.
